# Instawork Admin stories

**Instawork Admin:** Instawork staff who load reference data and invite the first Program User (D-26, D-82). Has no scope.

<a id="req-admin-web-0001"></a>

### Instawork Admin home: reference data and the first Program User

`REQ-ADMIN-WEB-0001` · first slice

- **Who:** Instawork Admin
- **What:** An Instawork Admin's home shows what reference data is loaded and lets them invite the first Program User. It also names the Instawork Admin menu.
- **Why:** Each persona gets its own view *(PLT-1: RBAC: unit (buyer), agency (supplier), corporate/program owner)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) PLT-1

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Instawork Admin menu lists Home, Positions, Markets, Labor rules, Account team, and Outside ids, in that order.
- **R2.** Home, the page an Instawork Admin lands on, has no to-do list; it shows how many active Positions, how many Markets, and how many Labor Rules in effect today, in the program timezone, are loaded.
- **R3.** While [`REQ-ORG-0005.R6`](business-rules.md#req-org-0005) allows a grant, Home offers Invite a Program User, which embeds the invite form of [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0007`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0007) with the role fixed to PROGRAM_USER.
- **R4.** Below the invite, Home lists each User with an unaccepted PROGRAM_USER invite, with their name, email, and invite date, and offers Send invite again and Revoke under [`REQ-ORG-0005.R15`](business-rules.md#req-org-0005).
- **R5.** While [`REQ-ORG-0005.R6`](business-rules.md#req-org-0005) refuses a grant, Home says a Program User is in place and offers no invite, and when [`REQ-ORG-0005.R18`](business-rules.md#req-org-0005) applies it names that User and offers Revoke after a confirmation.
- **R6.** Home lists the other Instawork Admins with name, email, and whether active, and offers Deactivate or Reactivate under [`REQ-ORG-0005.R19`](business-rules.md#req-org-0005).

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-ORG-0005` Grant a role within a scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0005)
- [`REQ-CATALOG-0001` Hold the Compass Position catalog](business-rules.md#req-catalog-0001)
- [`REQ-CATALOG-0002` Hold Markets and their ZIP codes](business-rules.md#req-catalog-0002)
- [`REQ-LABOR-0001` Hold state and local labor rules](business-rules.md#req-labor-0001)
- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

**Open questions it rests on**

<a id="req-admin-web-0002"></a>

### Keep the Compass Position catalog

`REQ-ADMIN-WEB-0002`

- **Who:** Instawork Admin
- **What:** On the Positions screen an Instawork Admin adds, renames, and deactivates the Positions that every Shift, Rate Line, and Credential Requirement names.
- **Why:** Every agency names jobs differently; Compass wants one set of titles *(RC-2: Standard Compass position catalog)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) RC-2

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Positions screen lists every Position by name, with whether it is active.
- **R2.** Add Position and Rename take a name and save through [`REQ-CATALOG-0001`](business-rules.md#req-catalog-0001), which refuses a name another Position has.
- **R3.** Deactivate calls [`REQ-CATALOG-0001`](business-rules.md#req-catalog-0001) after the screen says the Position can no longer be chosen for a new Shift or Rate Line and stays on existing records.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-CATALOG-0001` Hold the Compass Position catalog](business-rules.md#req-catalog-0001)
- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-26](open-questions.md#d-26) Who keeps reference data: Positions, Markets, and labor rules?
- [D-108](open-questions.md#d-108) Which rows does a list show first, where no source gives an order?

<a id="req-admin-web-0003"></a>

### Keep Markets and their ZIP codes

`REQ-ADMIN-WEB-0003` · first slice

- **Who:** Instawork Admin
- **What:** On the Markets screen an Instawork Admin adds and renames Markets and keeps the ZIP codes that belong to each.
- **Why:** Not given in Compass's sheet; the sources below are where it comes from.
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §3 Supplier Rates

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Markets screen lists every Market, sorted by state and then city, with the number of its ZIP codes.
- **R2.** Add Market and Rename take a city name and a two-letter state and save through [`REQ-CATALOG-0002`](business-rules.md#req-catalog-0002).
- **R3.** Opening a Market lists its ZIP codes, and Add ZIP code and Remove save through [`REQ-CATALOG-0002`](business-rules.md#req-catalog-0002), which refuses a ZIP code another Market holds.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-CATALOG-0002` Hold Markets and their ZIP codes](business-rules.md#req-catalog-0002)
- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-21](open-questions.md#d-21) What is a Market: a city, a metro, a state, or a set of ZIP codes?
- [D-26](open-questions.md#d-26) Who keeps reference data: Positions, Markets, and labor rules?
- [D-108](open-questions.md#d-108) Which rows does a list show first, where no source gives an order?

<a id="req-admin-web-0004"></a>

### Keep state and local Labor Rules

`REQ-ADMIN-WEB-0004`

- **Who:** Instawork Admin
- **What:** On the Labor rules screen an Instawork Admin adds, changes, and ends the state and city rules for breaks, minimum wage, and overtime.
- **Why:** Rules vary by state and city; compliance shouldn't depend on the operator *(WA-18: State and local labor rules (breaks, minimum wage) applied at booking and on timesheets)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) WA-18

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Labor rules screen lists every Labor Rule by state, city, and kind, with its threshold_minutes, break_minutes, or minimum_wage, effective_from, and effective_to, and filters by state and kind.
- **R2.** Add rule takes a state, an optional city, a kind, the values that kind needs, and effective_from, and saves through [`REQ-LABOR-0001`](business-rules.md#req-labor-0001).
- **R3.** Each rule offers Change, and End, which sets its effective_to, both through [`REQ-LABOR-0001`](business-rules.md#req-labor-0001).
- **R4.** The form says that a new rule for a state, city, and kind is refused until the earlier rule for them is ended.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-LABOR-0001` Hold state and local labor rules](business-rules.md#req-labor-0001)
- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-26](open-questions.md#d-26) Who keeps reference data: Positions, Markets, and labor rules?
- [D-108](open-questions.md#d-108) Which rows does a list show first, where no source gives an order?
- [D-199](open-questions.md#d-199) Which labor rules apply where none is loaded?

<a id="req-admin-web-0005"></a>

### Keep Instawork's account team for each part of the org

`REQ-ADMIN-WEB-0005`

- **Who:** Instawork Admin
- **What:** On the Account team screen an Instawork Admin names the Account Manager, Account Owner, and Support Lead for the whole program or any org node. It shows whom each Unit resolves to.
- **Why:** Not given in Compass's sheet; the sources below are where it comes from.
- **Sources:** Graph Instawork staff set a Company's account manager and account reps in Django admin

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Account team screen shows the program-wide member for each role, then the org tree with each node's own open assignments.
- **R2.** Assign takes a role and an active Instawork Admin for the whole program or one org node, and saves through [`REQ-ORG-0011`](business-rules.md#req-org-0011), which ends that role's open assignment there.
- **R3.** Remove ends an open assignment through [`REQ-ORG-0011`](business-rules.md#req-org-0011) after a confirmation.
- **R4.** Opening a Unit shows the member [`REQ-ORG-0011`](business-rules.md#req-org-0011) resolves for each role and the node that assignment belongs to, or none.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-ORG-0011` Assign Instawork's account team to parts of the org](business-rules.md#req-org-0011)
- [`REQ-ORG-0001` Hold the Compass org tree](business-rules.md#req-org-0001)
- [`REQ-ORG-0002` Add a Unit and its Departments](business-rules.md#req-org-0002)
- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-265](open-questions.md#d-265) Which Instawork account team roles does Iris keep for parts of the Compass org?

<a id="req-admin-web-0006"></a>

### Keep the ids other systems use for Iris records

`REQ-ADMIN-WEB-0006`

- **Who:** Instawork Admin
- **What:** On the Outside ids screen an Instawork Admin sets the Fieldglass, SAP, and MyStaff ids of Units, Departments, Companies, Agencies, and Positions.
- **Why:** Not given in Compass's sheet; the sources below are where it comes from.
- **Sources:** Graph Instawork's Business admin keeps outside ids such as salesforce_account_id and netsuite_id on the record

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Outside ids screen picks a system and a record type and lists every record of that type by name, or by name for a Company, with its id there or empty.
- **R2.** The list is searched by name, code, or id, and can show only records with no id in the picked system.
- **R3.** Set id and Remove save through [`REQ-INTEGRATIONS-0009`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-integrations-0009), and a refused id names the record that already holds it.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-ORG-0002` Add a Unit and its Departments](business-rules.md#req-org-0002)
- [`REQ-AGENCIES-0001` Add an Agency](business-rules.md#req-agencies-0001)
- [`REQ-CATALOG-0001` Hold the Compass Position catalog](business-rules.md#req-catalog-0001)
- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)
